name: GPU PERFORMANCE MODE
description: Sets GPU scheduling policy to favor raw rendering throughput over power savings.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers' -Name 'HwSchMode' -ErrorAction Stop).HwSchMode; if ($v -eq 2) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE POST-PROCESS FX
description: Disables driver-level post-processing effects and forced anti-aliasing overrides.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\NVIDIA Corporation\Global\NGXCore\FeatureControl' -Name 'FxaaEnabled' -ErrorAction Stop).FxaaEnabled; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE GPU POWER SAVING
description: Prevents the GPU from entering low-power idle states when not actively rendering.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$r = powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_GRAPHICS GPUPREFERENCEPOLICY 2>&1; if ($r -match '0x1') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE VSYNC
description: Disables vertical synchronization to uncap frame rates in applications.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\NVIDIA Corporation\Global\NVTweak' -Name 'NvCplUsePerfOptimization' -ErrorAction Stop).NvCplUsePerfOptimization; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: GPU PRIORITY MODE
description: Raises GPU process scheduling priority class for reduced input-to-display latency.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\GraphicsSettings' -Name 'GPUPreferences' -ErrorAction Stop).GPUPreferences; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE GPU TIMEOUT
description: Increases GPU timeout detection and recovery delay to prevent driver resets.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers' -Name 'TdrDelay' -ErrorAction Stop).TdrDelay; if ($v -eq 8) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: FORCE MULTI-GPU MODE
description: Enables explicit multi-GPU adapter rendering for compatible applications.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\GraphicsSettings' -Name 'MultiGpuSupport' -ErrorAction Stop).MultiGpuSupport; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: ENABLE GPU ACCELERATION
description: Forces GPU acceleration for all composited window rendering operations.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Avalon.Graphics' -Name 'DisableHWAcceleration' -ErrorAction Stop).DisableHWAcceleration; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE WDDM OPTIMIZATION
description: Disables WDDM driver optimizations that may introduce rendering overhead.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers' -Name 'PlatformOptimization' -ErrorAction Stop).PlatformOptimization; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: GPU TDR DELAY EXTEND
description: Extends the timeout detection and recovery delay for GPU driver hangs.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers' -Name 'TdrDdiDelay' -ErrorAction Stop).TdrDdiDelay; if ($v -eq 8) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE GPU MEMORY THROTTLING
description: Prevents the GPU memory controller from throttling bandwidth under load.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers' -Name 'MemoryThrottling' -ErrorAction Stop).MemoryThrottling; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: ENABLE SHADER CACHE
description: Enables persistent GPU shader cache for improved performance in repeated workloads.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers' -Name 'ShaderCache' -ErrorAction Stop).ShaderCache; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: GPU COMPUTE OPTIMIZATION
description: Optimizes GPU scheduling for compute workloads over graphics rendering.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers' -Name 'ComputeOptimization' -ErrorAction Stop).ComputeOptimization; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE GPU Flicker Mitigation
description: Turns off display flicker mitigation that can add rendering latency.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers' -Name 'FlickerMitigation' -ErrorAction Stop).FlickerMitigation; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: GPU MAXIMUM FRAME RATE
description: Sets a driver-level maximum frame rate cap for consistent rendering.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers' -Name 'GlobalFPSLimit' -ErrorAction Stop).GlobalFPSLimit; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE STORAGE SENSE
description: Turns off automatic Storage Sense cleanup that deletes files without user consent.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\StorageSense' -Name 'AllowStorageSenseGlobal' -ErrorAction Stop).AllowStorageSenseGlobal; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE SYSTEM TRAY NOTIFICATIONS
description: Disables the notification center and calendar flyout in the system tray.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer' -Name 'DisableNotificationCenter' -ErrorAction Stop).DisableNotificationCenter; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: ENABLE BSOD VERBOSE MODE
description: Shows detailed error information on Blue Screen of Death instead of a sad face.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\CrashControl' -Name 'DisplayParameters' -ErrorAction Stop).DisplayParameters; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: ENABLE CROSS-DEVICE RESUME
description: Enables clipboard history and cross-device resume functionality.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Clipboard' -Name 'EnableClipboardHistory' -ErrorAction Stop).EnableClipboardHistory; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE LOGON ACRYLIC BLUR
description: Removes the acrylic blur effect from the lock screen background.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System' -Name 'DisableAcrylicBackgroundOnLogon' -ErrorAction Stop).DisableAcrylicBackgroundOnLogon; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: ENABLE LOGON VERBOSE MODE
description: Shows detailed startup/shutdown messages during Windows boot and logon.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System' -Name 'VerboseStatus' -ErrorAction Stop).VerboseStatus; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE NEW OUTLOOK
description: Prevents the new Outlook app from replacing the classic Outlook client.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Office\16.0\Outlook\Options\General' -Name 'HideNewOutlookToggle' -ErrorAction Stop).HideNewOutlookToggle; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE MOUSE ACCELERATION
description: Turns off Windows mouse acceleration for consistent 1:1 cursor movement.
command: reg add "HKCU\Control Panel\Mouse" /v MouseSpeed /t REG_SZ /d 0 /f && reg add "HKCU\Control Panel\Mouse" /v MouseThreshold1 /t REG_SZ /d 0 /f && reg add "HKCU\Control Panel\Mouse" /v MouseThreshold2 /t REG_SZ /d 0 /f
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name 'MouseSpeed' -ErrorAction Stop).MouseSpeed; if ($v -eq '0') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE MULTIPLANE OVERLAY
description: Disables MPO to fix fullscreen stuttering and flickering issues in games.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Dwm' -Name 'OverlayTestMode' -ErrorAction Stop).OverlayTestMode; if ($v -eq 5) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE S0 SLEEP NETWORK
description: Disables network connectivity during modern standby (S0) to save battery.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Power\PowerSettings\f15576e8-98b7-4186-b944-eafa664402d9' -Name 'DCSettingIndex' -ErrorAction Stop).DCSettingIndex; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: ENABLE S3 SLEEP (DISABLE S0)
description: Forces classic S3 sleep instead of modern standby (S0) for better power savings.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power' -Name 'PlatformAoAcOverride' -ErrorAction Stop).PlatformAoAcOverride; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE SETTINGS HOME PAGE
description: Removes the promotional Home page from the Windows Settings app.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Settings\Homepage' -Name 'HideHomepage' -ErrorAction Stop).HideHomepage; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE FULLSCREEN OPTIMIZATIONS
description: Disables Windows fullscreen optimizations for better game compatibility and performance.
command: reg add "HKCU\System\GameConfigStore" /v GameDVR_FSEBehaviorMode /t REG_DWORD /d 2 /f && reg add "HKCU\System\GameConfigStore" /v GameDVR_HonorUserFSEBehaviorMode /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\System\GameConfigStore' -Name 'GameDVR_FSEBehaviorMode' -ErrorAction Stop).GameDVR_FSEBehaviorMode; if ($v -eq 2) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: SET TIME TO UTC
description: Sets Windows to use UTC time for the Real-Time Clock (RTC) instead of local time.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\TimeZoneInformation' -Name 'RealTimeIsUniversal' -ErrorAction Stop).RealTimeIsUniversal; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE RDP UNSIGNED FILE WARNINGS
description: Suppresses unsigned file warnings when opening files via Remote Desktop.
command: reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Terminal Server Client" /v ShowRedirectionWarningDialog /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Terminal Server Client' -Name 'ShowRedirectionWarningDialog' -ErrorAction Stop).ShowRedirectionWarningDialog; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE WINDOWS DEFENDER
description: Turns off real-time antimalware monitoring and scheduled system scans.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender' -Name 'DisableAntiSpyware' -ErrorAction Stop).'DisableAntiSpyware'; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE WINDOWS FIREWALL
description: Disables Windows Defender Firewall for all network profiles.
command: netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state off
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$r = netsh advfirewall show allprofiles 2>&1 | Out-String; if ($r -match 'States+ON') { exit 1 } else { exit 0 }"

name: DISABLE REMOTE ASSISTANCE
description: Disables Remote Desktop and Remote Assistance incoming connections.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server' -Name 'fDenyTSConnections' -ErrorAction Stop).'fDenyTSConnections'; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"
